children: Capri Global Capital Ltd’s gold lending arm, Capri Gold Loans, on Wednesday launched a four-day pan-India promotional campaign called ‘Vyapar Mahotsav’, running from September 16 to September 19, 2026. The initiative offers gold loans at interest rates starting 11 per cent per annum, with zero processing fees and maximum eligible loan value against pledged gold, subject to terms and conditions.

Capri Global Capital closed at ₹256.65 on Wednesday, up 0.61 per cent from the previous close of ₹255.10. The stock touched an intraday high of ₹267.25 and a low of ₹248.65. Traded volume stood at 76.21 lakh shares, with a traded value of ₹197.42 crore. The company’s total market capitalisation stands at approximately ₹24,694 crore.

The stock, part of the Nifty Smallcap 100 index, has gained roughly 37 per cent over the past year, significantly outperforming the Nifty 500’s decline of 3.58 per cent over the same period. Its 52-week high of ₹287.45 was recorded on September 7.

title: Capri Gold Loans rolls out ‘Vyapar Mahotsav’
